falsifier_requirement.trigger: CVSS fields leak into visible inputs, fewer than 20 CVEs are scored, NVD source hash changes, or prior-CWE comparator ties or beats the model within uncertainty.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Fit a training-only calibrated score regressor/classifier from CVE description tokens, CWE, CPE count, reference tags, and publication metadata; predict heldout CVSS base score and severity once.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.baseline_name: NVD prior-CWE median and prior-severity-frequency comparator
incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Predict heldout CVSS score from the training-only median score for the same CWE when present, otherwise the global prior median; severity comparator uses prior class frequencies.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: model residual must beat comparator residual under the declared domain-local metric

next_escalation: If status is CAPABILITY_DEVELOPMENT_REQUIRED, implement the listed script/flags/model support. If evidence remains negative, preserve fail-closed science and repair the model/comparator rather than flipping PASS.
no_fake_closure_policy: This execution cannot close broad superiority unless the downstream scoring and replay artifacts pass.
pass_predicate: A governed domain scorer script/flags exist, run cleanly, and the downstream domain-scoring report plus oc_prediction_scoring_row become PASS.
repair_strategy: Inspect the existing scorer output, repair the OC model/comparator/residual/materiality implementation, and preserve negative results if OC does not beat the comparator.

required_source_block.source_authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
required_source_block.source_name: NIST National Vulnerability Database CVE API 2.0

residual_requirement.formula: absolute CVSS-point residual per CVE; macro MAE by CWE stratum

target_variable.extraction_rule: CVSS score/severity are hidden until the prediction row is materialized from CVE text, CWE IDs, CPE counts, dates, and reference metadata.
target_variable.name: heldout_nvd_cvss_v31_base_score

uncertainty_requirement.metric: absolute CVSS-point residual per CVE; macro MAE by CWE stratum
uncertainty_requirement.rule: pre-holdout conformal residual interval stratified by CWE availability

why_it_failed: The governed domain scorer implementation produced a passing downstream scoring artifact.
